AG 000.5 (20 Jan 47) LS-R

APO 500
20 January 1947
MEMORANDUM FOR : IMPERIAL JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo.
SUBJECT : Results of War Crimes Trials.
The following War Criminals were executed at RABAUL, New Britain by the method and on the date stated after their names. They were executed in accordance with applicable law, by virtue of the order of Headquarters, Australian Military Forces, Melbourne, Victoria, Australia.
